description: Report documentation fell behind during busy simulation days, accumulating a backlog by Day 9.
response: All reports were eventually filed before departure.
lesson: Set a fixed daily reporting window (e.g., 1700-1800) and protect it from task bleed. The XO should chase all role reports before the comms window closes each evening.
